reply.text:
I'm not going to answer the gains part of that as a training question, because making yourself throw up after meals is something I need you to take seriously and talk to a doctor about. This isn't one I can coach around. Please reach out to a doctor, or a counsellor who works with eating difficulties, soon, and if you feel unsafe at any point, contact your local emergency number or a crisis line right away.

If it would help, tell me whether you'd like to talk about it with someone you trust, and I'll keep the training side on hold until you've had that conversation.
